internalMinorDiameterRule.scope: Only documented metric nut d/P pairs in a standard-family row; only pitches with an existing TD1Grade6 entry; shaft-v2 adaptation only. No external-thread dimension or rolling blank is inferred.
internalMinorDiameterRule.derivation: D1min = round(d − 1.082532 × P, 3) from ISO724:2023 clause5. H: EI=0 from ISO965-1:2013 clause5/Table1. D1max = D1min + TD1 grade6 from ISO965-1:2013 Table2. nutHole = midpoint rounded to 0.01mm; cutting-tap blank model, not forming-tap geometry.
